1f4f09e9.text:
Last night he was able to speak for the first time. He is a $c, called Heralath, sent to these parts to examine the rumors of the fallen boar god. 

In a weakened voice he told me that he believed the great boar skull to be the place where the great boar god Agamaggan fell battling the Burning Legion some 10,000 years ago during the War of the Ancients. His massive body flattened the land and his blood sank into the earth. Twisted spires of thorns grow where his blood fell...
1f4f09e9.title: Lonebrow's Journal

2f530ccb.text:
--Day One--

My journey from Ironforge finally brings me to Kalimdor!

Prospector Khazgorm of Bael Modan is making great headway. He uncovered a fossil today which the site scholars believe to be a bone fragment of an ancient god. Khazgorm is certain the fossil is part of a greater mystery. While he oversees the excavation site, he has made it my quest to discover more fossils to piece together the story. 

My assignment: head to the south in search of more clues.
2f530ccb.title: Lonebrow's Journal

42344755.text:
--Day Three--

Oh great and splendid discovery!

Whilst exploring today I came across a grand find: massive remains of what seems to have been a boar-like creature. Its skull towered many lengths above me. Each tooth of the beast could dwarf even... well a dwarf. Due to the sheer size of the find, I am lead to believe these are the remains of one of the rumored Old Gods.
42344755.title: Lonebrow's Journal

4a6356f5.text:
Poor Heralath looks pale as bone. His fever grows worse by the minute. All the while the boar men are preparing for some great military action. I fear that if I do not attempt my escape soon, I will meet a fate similar to my elven cell mate. 

My plan is to sneak out when the boar men leave for their next hunt. My guards are lazy and often sleep through their shifts.
4a6356f5.title: Lonebrow's Journal

70fc69d1.text:
--Day 5--

My night elf cell mate suffers from grave wounds. The boar men have whipped him repeatedly and I believe he will perish before long unless by some miracle a rescue party braves this treacherous place. He slips in and out of consciousness. When he awakes, I try to give him what little water I have.
70fc69d1.title: Lonebrow's Journal

7c46172c.text:
A while back, at the Explorers' League headquarters in Ironforge, I remember a lecture given by Chief Archeologist Greywhisker. The old chap made mention of such a god, one which was revered by the strange elves of Darnassus because of his rumored altruistic nature--

Bah! One moment. I hear snorting outside the tent. Surely just some thistle boars trying to get at my apple stash....
7c46172c.title: Lonebrow's Journal

9e06665c.text:
Roughly dragged inside of a foul-smelling, thorn infested bramble called Razorfen Kraul. Thrown inside a crudely crafted hut and held captive along with a dying night elf.

No possessions on me save for this journal, my quill and my pocket watch... 

Someone coming now...
9e06665c.title: Lonebrow's Journal

af44088d.text:
Heralath and his people seek to discover the source of corruption at this site. Agamaggan was believed to be a pure god, he told me. Why these foul creatures and malignant thorns scar the land is a mystery indeed.

Before I could press for more information, Heralath slipped into fitful sleep once again...
af44088d.title: Lonebrow's Journal

b654fe2d.text:
--Day 4--

Captured!

Must... write... quickly. 

Attacked by boar men of the Razorfen tribe. Believed they were taking me to the great boar remains of the fallen god. Instead, they skirted the great fossils and headed directly west of the giant skull, across the Gold Road.
b654fe2d.title: Lonebrow's Journal

d5e99cca.text:
--Day 6--

Heralath's condition worsens.

His eyes opened only once today. He spoke with pained anguish but his message was clear. If I were to escape my doom here in Razorfen Kraul, word must be gotten to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar that Charlga Razorflank was rousing minions in the southern Barrens. The power grows with each day. The Crone must be stopped before the plague of corruption can spread from the Kraul.
d5e99cca.title: Lonebrow's Journal

e98bea62.text:
--Day Two--

The lands of the Barrens are vast and expansive. My trek has been long and arduous and has yielded nothing of interest for the Explorers' League archives so far. 

The only incident of note took place near the gold road. Off in the distance I noticed some strange creatures. Half pig, half man it seemed. I quickly hid and let the foul beasts pass. My what a foul stench they left behind!
e98bea62.title: Lonebrow's Journal

f4967888.text:
Once free from the Kraul, I will head towards Thousand Needles and then west to Thalanaar on the border of the mysterious forest of Feralas. There I will seek the $c known as Falfindel Waywarder.

What began as an attempt to explore the past of my people has turned into something much larger. The protection of the Alliance lies in my hands....
f4967888.title: Lonebrow's Journal

11096|904d1c22.name: Randal Worth
11096|904d1c22.text: There's nothing I can teach you, other than maybe a better eye for color and detail. Talk to Simon Tanner over there; he knows a lot of advanced techniques for working with leather.

1286|ed056522.name: Edna Mullby
1286|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

1286|fe52f4ea.name: Edna Mullby
1286|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1292|ec1a6e0b.name: Maris Granger
1292|ec1a6e0b.text: I don't get too many Skinners in here looking for training, but I guess I could teach you something if you're ready.

1321|877c4b1d.name: Alyssa Griffith
1321|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2455|105cd232.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2455|6928abbf.name: Olivia Burnside
2455|6928abbf.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us ma'am?

247264|a8fa316f.name: Emissary Jacques
247264|a8fa316f.text:
Hail and well met, traveler.

I wish my arrival was met with good tidings but the realm of Dalaran is in need of aid from the kingdoms of the Alliance.

256732|9285f4a0.name: Alynsia
256732|9285f4a0.text: You look like you could use a few enchants. You have come to the right place!

256734|edaae191.name: Daniel Stitchsong
256734|edaae191.text: Hello there! I've got the finest leathers this side of Stormwind. Interested?

256735|8db10840.name: Mivin Shadowweave
256735|8db10840.text: <Mivin gestures toward his wares and back at you again with a smile, but says nothing.>

269127|1e33d6fe.name: Image of Archmage Modera
269127|1e33d6fe.text:
If you've tried to enter Dalaran, you've likely met with the Kirin Tor guards. They are under strict orders not to let outsiders into the city while this disruption runs rampant. The council has decreed that keeping up appearances is more important than preventing a catastrophe.

I suffer no such delusions.

2700|0efca734.name: Captain Nials
2700|0efca734.text:
We at Refuge Pointe hold one of the few remaining patches of Stromgarde territory in the Arathi Highlands.  And we're losing ground...

If you have words for me, then I hope they are good tidings.

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

3838|43c9021b.name: Vesprystus
3838|43c9021b.text: To maintain our link to the mainland, we have hippogryphs constantly flying between Rut'theran Village and Darkshore.

3845|10ec66f1.name: Shindrell Swiftfire
3845|10ec66f1.text: We elves have a long history.  Let us hope this history does not return to haunt us.

4319|c5ceacbe.name: Thyssiana
4319|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4321|c5ceacbe.name: Baldruc
4321|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4944|b1327f19.name: Captain Garran Vimes
4944|b1327f19.text:
We don't know much about the burning of the Shady Rest Inn, except that James Hyal's wife and child were unable to escape.

We managed to drag James out, but he hasn't been the same since.

We have many leads but not much evidence. It is our hope that through the efforts of the guard and the vigilant help of the people of Theramore, we will unravel this terrible crime.

If you would like to lend assistance to the investigation, what remains of the inn can be found at the border to the Barrens.

4944|dc13909f.name: Captain Garran Vimes
4944|dc13909f.text: The guards of Theramore are the finest group of Alliance soldiers based in Kalimdor. It is our duty to uphold the laws of the Alliance even so far away from our homes.

5564|30b7493c.name: Simon Tanner
5564|30b7493c.text: Sorry, but you've reached the limit of what I can teach. If you want to learn more, go see Telonis in the Craftsmen's Terrace of Darnassus. He's pretty talented, so I hear.

5565|877c4b1d.name: Jillian Tanner
5565|877c4b1d.text: I sell only the best gear, tested and true. And the prices are set, so if you want to haggle then go find a Goblin.

7870|975c76d8.name: Caryssia Moonhunter
7870|975c76d8.text: The forest told me of your presence, but not why you were here. So, speak and enlighten me.

7937|51417c16.name: High Tinker Mekkatorque
7937|51417c16.text: Hello there, $c. I am High Tinker Mekkatorque of the exiles of Gnomeregan.

7944|9a62fac1.name: Tinkmaster Overspark
7944|9a62fac1.text:
I am Tinkmaster Overspark, and I am the chief architect for modern gnomish engineering principles in the world today.  It is my job to ensure that the power of invention continues to shine brightest from our arclight spanners than anywhere else!

Also, if you happen to know a good schematic for radiation elimination, we just so happen to be in the market for one right about now...

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

4603-complete.name: Unknown
4603-complete.text:
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro.  Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.

The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!"  The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
4603-complete.title: More Sparklematic Action

4603-progress.name: Unknown
4603-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
4603-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

87318-complete.name: Essene Villard
87318-complete.text:
Corma sent you? That's great news!

When the Dark Irons ambushed us, we were separated, and I hit my head and couldn't tell which direction I was going. I wound up here and I've been living out of the supplies in my bag for the last few days. Now that you've made it past the Dark Irons, though, it may be possible for me to make my escape.

I just have to gather my things and take a moment to catch my senses, and I'll figure out a way to escape!

She never gave up on me. What a lovely heart.
87318-complete.title: Hearts of the Lost

88757-complete.name: Essene Villard
88757-complete.text:
You got my book! And my waterskin! And my necklace! Oh, good fortune finds me today... thank you so much.

I'd better make sure everything is intact!
88757-complete.title: Accessories of the Lost

88757-progress.name: Essene Villard
88757-progress.text: Just relacing my boots! Any luck getting past those Dark Irons and finding my things?
88757-progress.title: Accessories of the Lost

88758-complete.name: Corma Villard
88758-complete.text:
She's alive? She's alive!

Let me see this note... "Dear Corma..." mhmm... oh, blessed day! Thank the Light!

I can never thank you enough for reuniting us. I can't wait until she makes it back here!

You've done a wonderful service for us both.
88758-complete.title: Sentiments of the Lost

88758-progress.name: Corma Villard
88758-progress.text: Have you found any sign of her?
88758-progress.title: Sentiments of the Lost

92432-complete.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92432-complete.text:
I see Jacques was successful in garnering aid.

While not strictly permitted, we cannot allow our pride to turn away allies in our desperate hour. Do not let the guards fool you. Things are anything but under control.
92432-complete.title: An Alarming Request

92457-accept.name: Image of Archmage Modera
92457-accept.text:
The breach has affected many of our factotums and enchantments throughout the city, including many that are seeing to our defenses. This fragmented arcane energy has spoken to rogue elementals who seek to saturate themselves in this free flowing magic.

While we are busy tending to the wards and other major incidents, it would be a favor to the Kirin Tor if you could cull this elemental throng.
92457-accept.title: Starving Arcane

98071-accept.name: Brewmeister Bilger
98071-accept.text:
Worked a bit o' a trade with the Dun Garok brew-kin. We're not the only ones missin' the vineyards of the Fallrook family, it seems! Most o' the best bottled years are long since drank, but we do have cases of the wine still in the cellars. 

Bring this case of Fallrook Varietal to Dun Garok in the southeast and leave it with 'em by their gatherin' fireplace at the bottom of their fort.

In return, carry a sack o' the Homebrew Hops back with ye.

That keep is the closest thing to home around here!
98071-accept.title: Brewer's Trade

98155-complete.name: Kristy Grant
98155-complete.text: Thank you, $n! These hides are in perfect condition. I can't imagine it was easy to get so many, but I am very grateful to you for your work.
98155-complete.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

98155-progress.name: Kristy Grant
98155-progress.text: Were you able to collect the pelts? Rendow has promised to help me clean and tan them to send back home! I know my sisters will be very excited.
98155-progress.title: Pristine Pesterhide Pelts

98156-complete.name: Kimberly Grant
98156-complete.text:
This is from our sister? We hadn't heard from her in some time. I hope she is doing well.

My, these pelts have such a beautiful color of fur! Kelly and I will make sure we put these to good use.

Thank you for making the long journey. It is good to know Kristy is still doing well and is thinking of us.
98156-complete.title: Packaged Pristine Pelts
